jobs.description: Bike Mechanic - Amsterdam (Warehouse) Job Description  What you will do Ready to join Team Warehouse and to keep our blue wheels turning? At Swapfiets , we're on a mission to make biking the easy, sustainable choice for everyone. We keep our members on the go by providing a high-quality ride including free check-ups and repairs. Joining us means becoming part of this purposeful mission, and working alongside a great team in a fast-paced, fun environment to make it happen! As a bike mechanic at Swapfiets you are an essential part of the growth and continuity of Swapfiets. In this role you will repair all of our original and e-bikes without supervision. You are the expert in making sure our bikes are roadworthy and safe. Besides that, you will also make sure we deliver the Swapfiets quality day in, day out. How you pedal us forward! - You will be responsible for repairing our pedal bikes and our E-bikes with no supervision needed; - You will repair E-Bikes and pedal bikes and make them roadworthy; - You will ensure the Bikes' product and repair data is properly captured and up to date in repair database; - You will be handling special case repairs (in use, double frame numbers, founds, missings, special brokens that require documentation for insurance/police); - You will organize broken inflow and pre-organizing of the bikes (Triage); - We will make sure that you learn how to work in a safe way (safety is everyone's responsibility). The gear you need! - You have elementary knowledge about e-bikes and pedal bikes (cars or anything related can also be of help); - You have an affinity with cycling, mobility, sustainability and service; - Understand and speak English and/or Dutch; - Whether working independently or as part of a team, you always work successfully!; Benefits for a smooth ride! - Your own Swapfiets (lease); - A salary of €2795 per month - Fixed working hours/days possible. On weekdays, no weekend work; - ...

Do you enjoy leading an enthusiastic team and ensuring that clear processes run like a well-oiled machine? Start right away as a 4-Shift Team Leader in Oss! At this modern logistics center, you’ll work alongside a friendly team and use smart systems to get thousands of products to stores on time every day. A challenging role full of dynamism, leadership, and opportunities for growth!Are you curious to know what colleagues think of this position? Read on to find out about Joao's experience!What we offer- Salary between €2,500 and €3,600 per month!- An average of 30% extra shift and rotation premium- Plenty of time off 5 weeks a year- To your salary, you receive 8% vacation pay- A good retirement plan for the future!- Free fresh fruit and a hot lunch every day!Who you areFor the position of 4-Shift Team Leader, it is important that you meet the following requirements:- You speak English. Dutch is definitely welcome, too! However, your English must be at a good level, since your supervisors will also communicate with you in English;- You are willing to work in Oss;- You are available 36 hours per week;- You are willing to work 4 shifts (morning, afternoon, and night);- You have a vocational education (MBO) level of work and thinking;- You are familiar with Microsoft Word and Excel.What will you doAs a 4-shift team leader, you ensure that the department runs smoothly, safely, and efficiently. You directly manage a team of 10 to 20 operational employees and actively pitch in on the floor when needed.Your work schedule (36 hours per week). You’ll work a 4-shift rotation:- Morning shift: 6:00 a.m. – 2:30 p.m.- Afternoon shift: 2:00 p.m. – 10:30 p.m.- Evening/night shift: 10:00 p.m. – 6:30 a.m.- You lead your team and assign daily tasks;- You monitor agreements regarding budgets, productivity, and KPIs;- You coordinate staff scheduling with the production manager;- You coach and mentor your employees to foster a positive work environment;
